capitalExchangePreloadChainAuditLabel: Capital Exchange Preload Chain Findings Ready
productionDecision: No source code was changed. The audit identifies why capital.html preloads vendor-mapbox and prepares a targeted Capital/Exchange preload boundary patch.

sourceChainFindings.interpretation: If capital entry imports ExchangeRoutes statically, Rollup may include Exchange dependencies in capital preload graph.
If capital entry imports SHSExchangeMissionControl statically, it may pull Exchange/map dependency metadata early.
If pages-exchange chunk references vendor-mapbox, any static preload of pages-exchange may also preload Mapbox.
Vite helper __vite__mapDeps in capital chunk can cause vendor-mapbox to be included in the preload dependency list for a dynamic import.
capital.html directly preloads vendor-mapbox. This confirms early load risk at the generated HTML level.

preloadChainLikelyCause: capital entry generated chunk contains __vite__mapDeps for pages-exchange that includes vendor-mapbox.
pages-exchange generated chunk references vendor-mapbox, likely through Unified Truth / SHSOperationalMapboxMap.
dist/capital.html preloads vendor-mapbox directly, meaning the Capital entry is causing early Mapbox network pressure.
